title: Grief Class 1
speaker: Reizan Bob Penny
summary: Reizan Bob Penny's talk focuses on the importance of acknowledging and working through grief, rather than trying to suppress or avoid it. They encourage individuals to recognize that grief is a unique experience for each person, and by being aware of one's own process, they can better manage difficult emotions. By exploring their grief in a safe and reflective space, individuals can gain a deeper understanding of themselves and begin the healing process, rather than trying to fit into societal expectations or avoid painful emotions.
